failure_injection_points.name: Authorization drift
failure_injection_points.trigger: Request supplied with mismatched contract hash or modified mutation scope
failure_injection_points.expected_outcome: Fails closed at ingress with AUTHORIZATION_CONTRACT_DRIFT or AUTHORIZATION_SCOPE_MISMATCH

failure_injection_points.name: Stale Subject revision
failure_injection_points.trigger: Subject revision in store has incremented past expected_revision
failure_injection_points.expected_outcome: Fails closed with STALE_SUBJECT / StaleRevisionError; no mutation applied

failure_injection_points.name: Stale external authority precondition
failure_injection_points.trigger: Raw authority revision or digest differs from authorized observation
failure_injection_points.expected_outcome: Read-before-write rejects mutation with STALE_AUTHORITY; zero external write attempts

failure_injection_points.name: Duplicate control role comment
failure_injection_points.trigger: Issue contains >1 comment with the same control role marker
failure_injection_points.expected_outcome: Fails closed with CONTROL_ROLE_DUPLICATE; no heuristic selection

failure_injection_points.name: Durable journal CAS race
failure_injection_points.trigger: Concurrent executor attempts to CAS from PREPARED to APPLYING on same record
failure_injection_points.expected_outcome: Second executor receives StaleJournalRevisionError; exactly 1 external attempt executes

failure_injection_points.name: External write timeout
failure_injection_points.trigger: Transport raises TimeoutError during external mutate() call
failure_injection_points.expected_outcome: Surfaces OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; journal transitions to RECONCILING for mechanical recovery

failure_injection_points.name: Lost response / connection reset
failure_injection_points.expected_outcome: Surfaces OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; verify readback recovers true state

failure_injection_points.name: Verify readback failure
failure_injection_points.trigger: Re-read of external target fails after write attempt

failure_injection_points.name: Third-state observation
failure_injection_points.trigger: Readback observes raw digest differing from both original and candidate
failure_injection_points.expected_outcome: Classified as CONFLICT (J9); no auto-merge or heuristic resolution

failure_injection_points.name: Terminal journal persist failure (J10)
failure_injection_points.trigger: Durable store fails to persist terminal CAS transition
failure_injection_points.expected_outcome: Rolls back to nonterminal state; recovery scanner maps J10 to RECONCILING

failure_injection_points.name: Process crash & restart recovery
failure_injection_points.trigger: Store re-opened after crash while records in APPLYING / RECONCILING
failure_injection_points.expected_outcome: RecoveryScanner identifies nonterminals; RecoveryExecutor performs readback verify

failure_injection_points.name: Fresh authorization retry lineage
failure_injection_points.trigger: Retry attempted on RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT record with fresh lease
failure_injection_points.expected_outcome: Creates new journal record with distinct attempt_id linked via correlation_id
